mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_member (tenant_id, user_id, status, joined_at, access_level, identity_tags, creator_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{status}, NOW(3), #{accessLevel}, #{identityTags}, #{creatorId}, 0)

INSERT INTO org_member (tenant_id, user_id, status, joined_at, access_level, identity_tags, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{status}, NOW(3), #{accessLevel}, #{identityTags}, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE joined_at = IF(is_deleted = 1 OR status != 0, NOW(3), joined_at), status = 0, access_level = #{accessLevel}, identity_tags = #{identityTags}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, is_deleted = 0, gmt_modified = NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM org_member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM org_member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM org_member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0 ORDER BY joined_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE org_member SET access_level = #{accessLevel}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE org_member SET identity_tags = #{identityTags}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM org_member om1 WHERE om1.user_id = #{userId} AND om1.access_level = 'ADMIN' AND om1.is_deleted = 0 AND om1.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM org_member om2 WHERE om2.tenant_id = om1.tenant_id AND om2.user_id != #{userId} AND om2.access_level = 'ADMIN' AND om2.is_deleted = 0 AND om2.status = 0 )
